verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to connect external MCP servers to Trello so that it can call their tools. The only MCP item (trello-docs-6) describes Trello acting as an MCP server for other AI tools, which is the opposite role and does not count here. Power-Ups and app integrations are adjacent plugin mechanisms, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
